title: Synchronous 4-bit counter

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54160 thru SN54163 ... SN74160 thru SN74163 Synchronous 4-bit counters, bulletin DL-S 7611385 (October 1976)

pins.name: LOAD
pins.text: synchronous load: acts at the next rising clock edge

pins.name: ENABLE T
pins.text: also gates the ripple carry output; when low, the counter holds and RIPPLE CARRY is low

functions.text: QA is the least significant bit.

functions.formula: RIPPLE CARRY OUTPUT = ENABLE T AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD
functions.text: High at count 15 while ENABLE T is high; the pulse lasts about as long as the high part of QA. Used to enable the next stage.

rules: CLEAR low: QA-QD = 0 at once, regardless of clock, load and enable inputs
else LOAD low: QA,QB,QC,QD = A,B,C,D at the next rising clock edge, regardless of the enable inputs
else ENABLE P and ENABLE T both high: count up by one (binary, 0-15, wraps to 0) at each rising clock edge
Low-to-high transitions at LOAD should be avoided while the clock is low if the enable inputs are high at or before the transition
High-to-low transitions at ENABLE P or T should occur only while the clock is high

electrical.notes: Clock and ENABLE T inputs are double loads: IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA; other inputs -1.6 mA, 40 uA.
